notes.title: early, and buggy, proof of concept of roguelike mode available
notes.content:
I started working on the roguelike mode, "Adventure"! It's still very early and has many unfinished pieces in the current build, so there will be some bugs and crashes in this mode and bash related to items, so let me know if you run into any and wat to help fixing
Removed the April fools patch
Fixed bugs related to parry hit detection
Fixed bugs related to projectile hit detection not ignoring owning character

notes.title: Fixed issues with tutorial and credits
notes.content:
Thanks you for playing my first game and helping me find and fix issues with it!
Fixed default controls to be accurate for tutorial
Added leave button when finishing tutorial
Fixed credits having some names being cut off
Added leave button when killing all enemies in solo bash
